I think I see your problem. The initial positioning of your background image is being overridden by this:

@-webkit-keyframes scroll {
 from { background-position: 0; }
 to { background-position: -2250px; }
}
@keyframes scroll {
 from { background-position: 0; }
 to { background-position: -2250px; }
}

When the animation starts (which of course is immediately) it repositions the banner to { background-position: 0; }, so this is the value you need to change to properly position it.

From w3schools:

The first value is the horizontal position and the second value is the vertical. The top left corner is 0 0. Units can be pixels (0px 0px) or any other CSS units. If you only specify one value, the other value will be 50%. You can mix % and positions

So the value of 0 for this property actually means 0 50%. This should do what you want:

@-webkit-keyframes scroll {
 from { background-position: 0 22px; }
 to { background-position: -2250px 22px; }
}
@keyframes scroll {
 from { background-position: 0 22px; }
 to { background-position: -2250px 22px; }
}
